name: Teen and Adult Volunteer Program, Jefferson Abington Hospital
what_you_do: Help at a hospital just north of Philadelphia. You might help staff on patient floors, show people where to go, or sit with patients. You do not need any medical training.
who_can_apply: Anyone 16 or older who has the shots and health checks Jefferson asks for.
duration: Most assignments need at least 2 to 4 hours a week. Some late afternoon, evening or weekend shifts.
deadline_text: No deadline was posted as of Oct 16, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the form on the volunteer page. If they pick you, the hospital checks your record. You fill out some papers and show your shots: chicken pox, MMR, Tdap, a new TB blood test, and a flu shot in flu season.
notes: Volunteering here does not lead to a job, but it is health care experience for your resume. Shadowing is possible only if you find a staff member to supervise you yourself. Jefferson's Center City hospitals (TJUH and Methodist) take volunteers 18 and up only. Questions: 215-481-2492. As of Nov 4, 2026, the Jefferson site blocked automated reading, so confirm these details first. The volunteer page said age 16 on Oct 16, 2026, but the 2024 application form lists teen jobs for ages 17 and up. That form also asks for a Social Security number, so ask the volunteer office before you give it.
